Class GUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.client.view.gui.GUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
UI
public class GUI extends Object implements UI
Main Graphical User Interface orchestrator. Implements UI to offer a single standard access point for view updates.
